title: Record the spare bits in the online storage budget
body:
## Summary
- The prefix bound `2^(8p+18) p^2` is the widest of the 13 published online magnitudes.
- For every precision `p >= 101` its bit length leaves at least 56 bits inside `G = 8p + 8 ceil(log2(p+2)) + 32`, which covers the claimed twelve spare bits.
- All 2,600 bit lengths for precisions 101 through 300 fit in `G-56`. The selected κ is unchanged.
